# Antonio's Italian Bistro

> Antonio's Italian Bistro provides sophisticated Italian dining in Darien, Connecticut, offering a comprehensive menu of classic dishes, fresh salads, traditional pasta, meat and seafood entrees, and brick oven pizzas. Known for generous portions and daily specials, the bistro delivers a refined yet classic Italian culinary experience.

## Menu
Antonio's Italian Bistro offers a comprehensive menu of classic Italian dishes, featuring appetizers, fresh salads, traditional pasta, chicken, veal, and seafood entrees. They are also known for their brick oven pizzas and generous portions, often featuring daily specials.
